name: Olimpbet
note: Betting brand; official partner of several KHL clubs (CSKA, Severstal, Spartak, Sochi, Amur) and of SKA per the archived club site. Russian legal entity ООО «БК 'Олимп'» (Moscow). The ultimate owners are not publicly disclosed; an Inbusiness.kz (Atameken Business) investigation of the Kazakh namesake bookmaker Olimp (2019) found several companies working under the 'Olimp' trademark with opaque ownership. Searched 2026-10-03; remains unrated because no owner could be named from an openable source.
